card.name: Digits 3, 4 and 5 in quantities
card.fires_on: The digit 3 (or 4, or the word three) at the start of a quantity or range, such as an amount, duration, or measurement. It is strongest when the number leads a figure like 3 to 7.5 g or 45 million.

modes.label: Leading digit of a number
modes.description: A 3, 4 or 5 that starts or continues a multi-digit figure or range.
modes.example: we could prevent more than 4<<5>> million tons of annual CO2 emissions

modes.label: Small count before a unit
modes.description: The digit or word three before a unit of amount or time.
modes.example: those who ate <<3>> tablespoons of tomato paste daily for ten weeks

modes.label: Dose or duration range
modes.description: A 3 opening a range of doses or hours.
modes.example: sufficient sodium bicarbonate (<<3>> to 7.5 g daily)

card.plain: It fires on the number 3 (sometimes 4 or 5) when it begins an amount, range or time span.
